definitions.explanation: Physical or mental exertion for wages or production; work as an economic activity.

notes:
USAGE: {労働|ろうどう} refers to work in an economic or social context, often emphasizing the physical or productive aspect of work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {労働|ろうどう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (worker, laborer)
- {労働|ろうどう}⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧ (labor union)
- {労働|ろうどう}⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (working conditions)
- {労働|ろうどう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (working hours)
